name: daylight-simple
description: IXT-SUITES: daylight & ventilation check (pro). Hidden in Simple, present in Pro; the panel (#daylightPanel) mounts with the per-room glazing/ventilation breakdown. Mobile bottom-sheet; back-to-Simple hides it. Also asserts an interior room with no facade wall (Household Shelter) renders as a neutral N/A row, not a red failure.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-simple-hidden
steps.failMessage: daylight should be OFF in Simple mode

steps.name: assert-pro-on
steps.failMessage: daylight should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: scroll-to-shelter
steps.eval: (()=>{const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('#daylightPanel .ci-title')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('Household Shelter')); if(!t) throw new Error('no Household Shelter row'); t.closest('.clr-item').scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return t.closest('.clr-item').className})()

steps.name: assert-shelter-not-error
steps.eval: (()=>{const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('#daylightPanel .ci-title')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('Household Shelter')); const row=t.closest('.clr-item'); if(row.classList.contains('err')) throw new Error('shelter row still styled as an error'); const b=row.querySelector('.badge'); if(b.textContent.trim()!=='N/A') throw new Error('shelter badge is '+b.textContent); if(!row.textContent.includes('no external wall')) throw new Error('missing interior-room note'); return 'ok'})()

steps.name: assert-kitchen-still-fails
steps.eval: (()=>{const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('#daylightPanel .ci-title')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Kitchen'); if(!t) throw new Error('no Kitchen row'); const row=t.closest('.clr-item'); if(!row.classList.contains('err')) throw new Error('Kitchen should still read as a failure - over-suppression'); return 'ok'})()
